tests_proposed.reason: Coordinator must validate the BuildKit cache mount and Maven mirror after the active initial setup/build finishes.

assumptions: The project uses only released dependencies available from Maven Central; the mirror intentionally routes all Maven repositories through Central.
The BuildKit-capable Docker builder is available for the requested cache mount.
Frozen Java, Spring, MyBatis and artifact-name contracts remain unchanged.
notes: The Dockerfile keeps the pinned Maven 3.9.11/Temurin 21 builder, Java 21 non-root runtime, healthcheck, jar path and first-setup -DskipTests behavior.

The BuildKit /root/.m2 cache mount preserves downloaded Maven artifacts across source-changing image builds; the Maven settings mirror all repositories to Central to avoid snapshot or milestone repository attempts.
No source files, build outputs, Docker state, Git state, environment files or shared project records were modified.
